name: Smith Machine Single-Leg Calf Raise
aliases: One-Leg Smith Machine Standing Calf Raise
steps: Stand with the bar across your upper back and release the hooks with both feet planted.
Shift onto one foot, lift the other clear and keep a slight bend in your standing knee.
Press through the ball of your standing foot to raise your heel as high as possible, squeezing your calf tightly at the top.
Lower your heel slowly back to the floor, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Push evenly through the ball of your foot without rolling outward onto the edge of your ankle.
Control every lowering phase cleanly without bouncing out of the bottom.
